review_candidates.title: Senior Consultant - People Consulting - Change Management - Cairo
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Senior Consultant will support the design and delivery of change management strategies for transformation initiatives, including organizational transformation, digital transformation, and technology implementation programs. The role requires collaboration with client stakeholders to drive adoption, minimize resistance, and ensure realization of business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Change Strategy & Planning Support the development of change management strategies aligned with project objectives. Conduct change impact assessments and stakeholder analyses. Develop change management plans covering communications, engagement, training, sponsorship, and resistance management. Identify change risks and mitigation actions. Stakeholder Engagement Build relationships with client stakeholders across all organizational levels. Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and focus groups. Support executive and leadership engagement activities. Develop stakeholder engagement and influence strategies. Communication & Engagement Contribute to developing communication plans and key messages. Create communication materials including presentations, newsletters, emails, FAQs, and leadership talking points. Support change campaigns and employee engagement initiatives. Training & Adoption Conduct training needs assessments. Support development of learning and capability-building materials. Coordinate and facilitate workshops and training sessions. Monitor adoption and readiness levels. Organizational Change Management Delivery Support organizational change management within organizational transformation, digital transformation programs, or ERP implementation programs. Learn and apply leading change management methodologies and best practices (e.g., Prosci ADKAR). Project Management & Reporting Track change management activities and deliverables. Prepare status reports, dashboards, and executive updates. Coordinate with project management, HR, technology, and business teams. Support quality assurance and deliverable reviews. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related field. Master's degree is preferred. Prosci Change Management, APMG Change Management Practitioner, or ACMP certified change management professional certificates preferred. Additional certifications in project management or organizational development are an advantage. Experience 3 to 6 years of experience in change management focusing on Digital transformation, HR transformation, or ERP implementations. Exposure to AI programs is a plus Experience supporting large-scale business or digital transformation programs. Experience within professional services or management consulting and technology consulting firms is preferred. Experience working with government, public sector, financial services, or large enterprise clients is advantageous. Technical Skills Change Management within digital transformation and ERP implementation context Change Impact Assessment Stakeholder Management Communications Planning Training & Learning Design Change Readiness Assessment Benefits Realization PowerPoint and Executive Presentation Development Behavioral Competencies Strong communication and presentation skills. Excellent stakeholder management capabilities. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and in team environments. Strong business writing skills. Client-centric mindset. Adaptability and resilience in dynamic environments. Success Measures Effective contribution to the delivery of change management workstreams. Positive stakeholder engagement and satisfaction. Achievement of adoption and readiness targets. Timely delivery of project deliverables. Collaboration and knowledge-sharing activities.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Market Data
review_candidates.description: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Your Role: As a senior software engineer, you will help build and scale the systems and services that form the foundation of Alpaca and empower millions of users who are trading billions of dollars worth of assets. The market data team is responsible for improving the overall architecture of Alpaca connected to data products such as stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange markets. Oversee their public API structure and documentation on both streaming and historical endpoints. The team is responsible for building a cohesive developer-first API and is tasked with planning, ideating, experimenting, and putting into production the new services, and libraries that overcome some of our greatest technical challenges as we continue to scale rapidly. We are looking for senior or staff engineers who are keen on providing quality solutions, have great fundamentals, have proven experience building and architecting at scale, and are not afraid of challenging conventions. This demanding team also requires a deep understanding of POSIX-like operating systems, modern infrastructure, and orchestration practices. Things You Get To Do: Design highly scalable, mission-critical market data provider services Maintain good software quality and test coverage Participate in code reviews Troubleshooting on incidents and reported bugs Who You Are (Must-Haves): BSc/MSc or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field Minimum 3 years of experience of backend software development Hands-on experience with Docker or Kubernetes DevOps mindset Excited about what we are building at Alpaca Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies Who You Might Be ( Nice-to-Haves): Experience working with large datasets Experience with Kubernetes (CKA or CKAD certification is a plus) Experience with SQL Experience with IP networking Good understanding of the financial market Experience with any of the major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) Hands-on knowledge with shell scripting, Linux & Docker Knowledge of microservice architectures Knowledge of clean code principles Our Tech & Infrastructure Stack: GoLang (primary), Python REST, gRPC, Websockets, SSE Docker, Kubernetes Google Cloud Services (Google Kubernetes Engine, BigTable) Prometheus, Grafana, ELK How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. Recruitment Privacy Policy

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform / Semantic Layer
review_candidates.description: Basic Qualifications Education Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 years relevant experience. Clearance Requirements: Ability to obtain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required. Responsibilities For This Position ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES: As a Senior Software Engineer engineer for the AI Reliability Engineering (AIRE) organization, you’ll be responsible for: Designing and building APIs for AI/agent consumption that expose business concepts and metrics rather than raw tables, so callers work in business terms instead of navigating source systems. Building the logic that turns a business question into a validated, governed query and returns results with the appropriate access controls and provenance. Integrating with and querying both transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) data sources through governed access, respecting the grain, join semantics, and performance characteristics of each. Ensuring governed answers: enforcing access controls in the serving path, carrying data-sensitivity handling through responses, and routing data access to governed views where source-system security applies. Building tooling that grounds the platform in real usage, surfacing the datasets, metrics, and relationships people actually query. Collaborating with data architects and functional data owners to build to a shared definition contract, and with the AI/agent teams who consume the service. We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences: Strong backend service engineering: Experience shipping production REST or gRPC services with authentication / authorization and an eye for latency and reliability. Demonstrated API design for AI/agent consumption, e.g., tool/function-calling interfaces, retrieval/RAG backends, or LLM-orchestration services. Genuine working fluency across both OLTP and OLAP: Experience designing and building against a transactional database and an analytical warehouse. Strong SQL, including experience writing code that generates or compiles queries (semantic/metrics layer, query builder, ORM internals, or similar), not only hand-authored SQL. What sets you apart: Experience with a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML, or similar). Hands-on experience with an enterprise data warehouse and/or a data-virtualization platform. Experience with Rust and/or Python. Exposure to knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or reconciling shared identifiers across systems. Background in defense, manufacturing, or other complex multi-system enterprise environments. Our Commitment to You: An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development. Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule) Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits Workplace Options: This position is eligible for Remote, Hybrid or 100% Onsite. You must be located near a core GDMS location: Scottsdale AZ, Chantilly VA, Bloomington MN, Greensboro NC, Dedham MA, Taunton MA, Pittsfield MA, Orlando FL, San Jose CA, Pittsburgh PA Target salary range: USD $157,487.00/Yr. - USD $174,713.00/Yr. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled. Company Overview General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team! Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans
